decision_basis: Growing AWS profitability and 33% TTM CFO growth are meaningful, but negative quarterly/TTM FCF and a$63.246bn long-term debt increase create an observed owner-cash deficit. Investment-gain-distorted trailing P/E and an incomplete rebound do not supply offsetting cheapness.
manager_assessment: Agree independently with the manager on measured restraint; stronger operations preserve upside without cancelling actual financing and cash deficits.
score_interpretation: Signed strength of the present evidence-supported thesis; not a win probability or historical edge.
